data.body: Fixed: The bug was already resolved in commit 01b3e02 (fix: block PR when all findings are synthetic, a8f6-4c5e). At the bug's code_version (13183cd), the all-synthetic check in runner.py emitted a WARNING and returned 0; the fix changed it to emit ERROR and return 1. Added regression test test_runner_exits_1_when_all_agents_hit_context_window that exercises the full deep-tier scenario (5 agents all returning fallback_exhausted due to ContextWindowExceededError) and asserts exit 1.
